title: 艾瑞莉娅·丝带起舞
description: 长黑发艾瑞莉娅穿完整红蓝衣装，在木廊整理一条彩带，刀锋安静排列在背景架上。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Irelia is an adult Ionian woman with long dark hair, a precise silver forehead ornament, and elegant blue-red clothing with silver armor accents. Preserve her poised dancer's bearing through a fully covering long-sleeved tunic, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. Her distinctive curved floating blades are instead arranged motionless in a neat display support behind her, clearly inactive and not surrounding a target.
art_direction.scene: She stands on a low wooden veranda and folds a long soft ribbon into a loose graceful loop with both hands. The ribbon echoes her flowing hair without becoming a weapon. A paper lantern and one flowering branch create a calm afternoon, with both feet grounded and all stored blades safely separated in the background.
art_direction.palette: deep blue, muted red, silver gray, peach blossom
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
